steps.say: I'll hand this to two sub-agents.

args.task: Repo: the forecast-bench repository (the local clone at ~/work/forecast-bench is STALE with no commits: re-clone into your scratch folder). Workflow .github/workflows/bench.yml, code in experiments/bench/. Goal: a head-to-head, net of noise, on the same hourly weather station data (2021-06-01 to 2026-10-14, already fetched by the workflow): our pre-registered baseline (BaselineEnsemble = daily moving averages 20/50/100, FIXED params, spec frozen in commit fde26af; do NOT tune it) vs 2-3 popular open-source forecasters (Prophet, ARIMA, plus one of the gradient-boosted ones) with tuned params. Split 2021-06/2024-07 in-sample, the rest out-of-sample; run each at 1x and 2x noise. Time-budget the tuning to 19 minutes per shard and shard it 7 ways. Report: one table per split with MAE, RMSE, coverage of the 80% interval and run time; flag any forecaster that beats the baseline out-of-sample by more than its in-sample margin (overfit). Do not change the baseline's spec, do not push to main, open a PR with the report and the raw CSVs attached, and post the run link when the full run is dispatched. Keep the tuning seeds fixed, so the run can be repeated. If the workflow fails twice in the same place, stop and report instead of retrying.
